reply.text:
That's a question for a doctor, not a coach. Three hours a day is a lot of volume, and whether it's safe for you depends on your fitness level, your health, and what else is going on in your life — stuff I can't assess.

What I can tell you: I build training that works. Longer isn't always better, and it often backfires. We can talk about your goals and what you're actually trying to do, and I'll build something that fits. What's driving this — are you stuck on progress, or just want to speed things up?
